£85 INSURANCE REGULATORY AND
iedlesi. DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA
## **Ref: IRDAI/F&I/CIR/MISC/142/11/2026 Date: 02.11.2026** ## **Master Circular on Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers, 2026** The Authority has notified the IRDAI (Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 (herein after referred to as “Registration Regulations, 2024”). The said Regulations have been amended vide the IRDAI (Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 (hereinafter referred to as Registration (Amendment) Regulations, 2026). 2. In exercise of the powers conferred by section 34 of the Insurance Act, 1938 (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”), section 14 of the IRDA Act, 1999 and Regulation 59 and 60 of Registration Regulations, 2024, the Authority hereby issues this Master Circular to specify various forms as referred in the Registration Regulations, 2024 and to provide clarifications on various provisions of the Registration Regulations, 2024. 3. This Master Circular shall come into force from the date of its issuance and shall be applicable to all Insurers (excluding Foreign Reinsurer’s Branches) and applicants seeking registration to carry on insurance business. 4. This has approval of the Competent Authority. Sd/Chief General Manager Mahesh Agarwal Survey No. 115/1, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Hyderabad – 500032 Phone: 040-20204000, Web: www.irdai.gov.in Page **1** of **17** ## **Table of Contents** |**Chapter**|**Description**|**Page No.**| |---|---|---| |I|Applications to be submitted|3| |II|Clarifications, Submission of Returns and Transitory Provisions|4| ||**Schedule I**– List of Repealed Circulars|10| ||**Annexure – 1**: Form IRDAI/NOC|11| ||**Annexure – 2 :**Form IRDAI/R4|12| ||**Annexure – 3 :**Form IRDAI/ToS: Application for approval u/s 6A|13| Page **2** of **17** ## **Chapter – I: Applications to be submitted** ## A.1 No-objection Certificate (NOC) [refer Regulation 6(1)(b) of Registration Regulations, 2024]: The application for issuance of No-Objection Certificate (NOC), as referred in Regulation 6(1)(b) of Registration Regulations, 2024 shall be in the form IRDAI/NOC as per Annexure 1. The application shall be submitted to IRDAI, at email ID registrations-cell@irdai.gov.in. Further, physical copy of the duly authenticated application shall also be sent to In-charge of Registration Cell at following address: “In-charge, Registration Cell Finance and Investment Department, Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India, Survey No. 115/1, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Gachibowli, Hyderabad – 500032, Telangana, India” The application may also be submitted online at IRDAI website i.e. www.irdai.gov.in [currently, the form to apply for NOC for ‘New Insurers Registration’ is placed under the ‘E-services’ section on the website of the Authority.] ## B.1 Application for Issuance of Form IRDAI/R1 [refer Regulation 6(1)(c) of Registration Regulations, ## 2024]: The application for issuance of Form IRDAI/R1, as referred in Regulation 6(1)(c) of Registration Regulations, 2024 shall be made on the letter head of the applicant, duly signed by its authorized person and shall be accompanied with the following documents: - i. Copy of Certificate of Incorporation of the applicant. - ii. Copy of Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the applicant. iii. A Resolution passed by the Board of the promoter(s) of the applicant for following: a. Approval for entering into the insurance business. b. Authorization of person to act on behalf of the promoter(s). - iv. A Resolution passed by the Board of the applicant for the following: - a. Approval for entering into the insurance business. - b. Authorization of person to act on behalf of the applicant. C.1 Format of Form IRDAI/R4, as referred to in Regulation 57 of Registration Regulations, 2024, is at Annexure 2. D.1 Format of Form IRDAI/ToS, as referred to in Chapter IV of Registration Regulations, 2024 is at Annexure 3. Page **3** of **17** **Chapter- II: Clarifications, Submission of Returns and Transitory Provisions** **A.1 With respect to Regulation 21:** With regard to shares allotted pursuant to Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) or any other similar scheme for the benefit of the employees or directors of the insurer, the following shall be complied with: 1. Exercise of ESOP is subject to provisions of section 6A(4)(b) of the Act read with Registration Regulations, 2024. 2. Where specific trust has been formed by an insurer for issuance of ESOPs to their employees, the issue of shares to such trust and exercise of option by one or more employees shall also fall within the ambit of the section 6A(4)(b) of the Act read with Registration Regulations, 2024. 3. Where exercise of ESOP by one or more KMPs or Directors, whether singly or jointly, is beyond the threshold limit specified in section 6A(4)(b) of the Act read with Registration Regulations, 2024, the prior approval of the Authority shall be sought before such exercise, in the manner as specified in Regulation 22 of the Registration Regulations, 2024. A.2 Regulation 21 of the Registration Regulation, 2024 shall be applicable to all insurers including the insurers having its equity shares listed on the stock exchange(s). The insurer shall put-in place necessary mechanism to ensure compliance with the said Regulations including necessary communication with stock exchange(s) and capital market intermediaries such as Registrar and Transfer Agent or Depository Participant. It shall be duty of the concerned insurer to ensure compliance with the said Regulation. **B.1 With respect to Regulation 29(5) of Registration Regulations, 2024:** The insurer shall submit the application seeking prior-approval for transfer of shares as per the form IRDAI/ToS, as specified in **Annexure-3** of this Circular, subject to following additional requirements: 1. The details of transferee may be furnished if the same is available. In case the details of transferee are unavailable or unascertainable, the same shall not be mandatory to be furnished. 2. The resolution passed by the Board of insurer, certified by the Company Secretary, approving the issuance of capital/ offer for sale proposed shall also be submitted along with the application. 3. The following particulars regarding issuance or transfer of capital, pursuant to proposed listing, shall be furnished: - i. Purpose of Initial Public Offer (IPO) - ii. Size of IPO - a. Total amount - b. Fresh issuance of shares by the insurer - c. Offer for sale by the existing shareholders iii. Shareholding pattern as per the following format |S.|Name

A synopsis / executive summary of the proposed transaction and the terms on which such transaction has been contemplated. 4. Financial Reports - a. Audited financial statements including notes to accounts of each of the transacting entities for financial year immediately preceding the date on which the notice of intention is made. - b. Financial statements including notes to accounts of each of the transacting entities for Page **5** of **17** quarter ended immediately preceding the date on which the notice of intention is made. 5. Financial Statements of the merged entity, on pro-forma basis, as at the appointed date of the Scheme. 6. A report by an independent actuary, who has not been professionally connected with any of the parties concerned in the amalgamation or transfer at any time in the five years preceding the date on which he signs his report, on impact of proposed amalgamation or transfer on transferee insurer with respect to: - a. Technical Reserves - b. Solvency position - c. Pricing of the products - d. Financial condition 7. A report on the manner in which the interest of policyholders will be protected and a report on compliance with the applicable laws. 8. Structure of the transacting entities including - a. Shareholding pattern - b. Corporate structure - c. Proposed status in the transferee insurer (i.e. promoter or investor) - d. Country of residence 9. Resolutions - a. Board Resolution of the transacting entities approving the proposed scheme of amalgamation or transfer. - b. Special resolution passed by shareholders at a general body meeting/extraordinary general meeting of the transacting entities about their intent to pursue the amalgamation or transfer contemplated in the Scheme. 10. Governance related aspects - a. Composition of Board of Directors of the merged entity along with the role of senior management. - b. Compliance with the Regulations/Circulars on Corporate Governance issued by the Authority. 11. Applications submitted to or approval granted by the other Regulators, as may be applicable, in respect of the proposed scheme. 12. Details of Impact on and changes related to operations of the insurer, including - a. Information Technology. - b. Business processes. - c. Distribution Channels/Intermediaries and Branch Network. - d. Existing range of products - e. Scheme on Key Contracts. - f. Reinsurance strategies and Protection and Maintenance of Reinsurance Assets. 13. Such other information which may be required from time to time till the grant of final approval to the Scheme. Proof of payment of processing fees as per regulation 36 of Registration Regulations, 2024. 2. Details of changes in information submitted along with notice of intention. **C.3 With respect to Regulation 34(6) of Registration Regulations, 2024:** The transferee insurer shall, within 30 days of the implementation of the scheme, furnish the following documents and information to the Authority: 1. Copy of notice in the newspaper about completion of the process as per Regulation 34(5) of Registration Regulations, 2024. 2. Confirmation by the CEO of the transferee insurer that the scheme has been implemented in compliance with the applicable law and conditions stipulated by NCLT and other statutory/regulatory bodies. 3. Certificate from statutory auditor of the transferee insurer regarding: - a. Confirmation on completion of the process in accordance with the Scheme approved by NCLT. - b. Confirmation that all the policyholders’ liabilities and assets of transferor entity have been transferred to transferee insurer. - c. chunks.heading: **Master Circular on Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers, 2026**
chunks.content:
The Authority has notified the IRDAI (Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers) Regulations, 2024 (herein after referred to as “Registration Regulations, 2024”). The said Regulations have been amended vide the IRDAI (Registration, Capital Structure, Transfer of Shares and Amalgamation of Insurers) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 (hereinafter referred to as Registration (Amendment) Regulations, 2026). 

2. In exercise of the powers conferred by section 34 of the Insurance Act, 1938 (hereinafter referred to as “the Act”),  section 14 of the IRDA Act, 1999 and Regulation 59 and 60  of Registration Regulations, 2024, the Authority hereby issues this Master Circular to specify various forms as referred in the Registration Regulations, 2024 and to provide clarifications on various provisions of the Registration Regulations, 2024. 

3. This Master Circular shall come into force from the date of its issuance and shall be applicable to all Insurers (excluding Foreign Reinsurer’s Branches) and applicants seeking registration to carry on insurance business. 

4. This has approval of the Competent Authority. 

Sd/Chief General Manager

chunks.heading: <u>A.1 No-objection Certificate (NOC) [refer Regulation 6(1)(b) of Registration Regulations, 2024]:</u>
chunks.content:
The application for issuance of No-Objection Certificate (NOC), as referred in Regulation 6(1)(b) of Registration Regulations, 2024 shall be in the form IRDAI/NOC as per Annexure 1. The application shall be submitted to IRDAI, at email ID <u>registrations-cell@irdai.gov.in. Further, physical copy of the duly</u> authenticated application shall also be sent to In-charge of Registration Cell at following address: 

“In-charge, Registration Cell 

Finance and Investment Department, Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India, Survey No. 115/1, Financial District, Nanakramguda, 

Gachibowli, Hyderabad – 500032, Telangana, India” 

The application may also be submitted online at IRDAI website i.e. www.irdai.gov.in [currently, the form to apply for NOC for ‘New Insurers Registration’ is placed under the ‘E-services’ section on the website of the Authority.]

chunks.heading: <u>2024]:</u>
chunks.content:
The application for issuance of Form IRDAI/R1, as referred in Regulation 6(1)(c) of Registration Regulations, 2024 shall be made on the letter head of the applicant, duly signed by its authorized person and shall be accompanied with the following documents: 

- i. Copy of Certificate of Incorporation of the applicant. 

- ii. Copy of Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the applicant. 

iii. A Resolution passed by the Board of the promoter(s) of the applicant for following: a. Approval for entering into the insurance business. 

b. Authorization of person to act on behalf of the promoter(s). 

- iv. A Resolution passed by the Board of the applicant for the following: 

   - a. Approval for entering into the insurance business. 

   - b. Authorization of person to act on behalf of the applicant. 

C.1 Format of Form IRDAI/R4, as referred to in Regulation 57 of Registration Regulations, 2024, is at Annexure 2. 

D.1 Format of Form IRDAI/ToS, as referred to in Chapter IV of Registration Regulations, 2024 is at Annexure 3.

**<u>Chapter- II: Clarifications, Submission of Returns and Transitory Provisions</u>** 

**A.1 With respect to Regulation 21:** With regard to shares allotted pursuant to Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) or any other similar scheme for the benefit of the employees or directors of the insurer, the following shall be complied with: 

1. Exercise of ESOP is subject to provisions of section 6A(4)(b) of the Act read with Registration Regulations, 2024. 

2. Where specific trust has been formed by an insurer for issuance of ESOPs to their employees, the issue of shares to such trust and exercise of option by one or more employees shall also fall within the ambit of the section 6A(4)(b) of the Act read with Registration Regulations, 2024.

chunks.heading: <u>2024]:</u>
chunks.content:
3. Where exercise of ESOP by one or more KMPs or Directors, whether singly or jointly, is beyond the threshold limit specified in section 6A(4)(b) of the Act read with Registration Regulations, 2024, the prior approval of the Authority shall be sought before such exercise, in the manner as specified in Regulation 22 of the Registration Regulations, 2024. 

A.2 Regulation 21 of the Registration Regulation, 2024 shall be applicable to all insurers including the insurers having its equity shares listed on the stock exchange(s). The insurer shall put-in place necessary mechanism to ensure compliance with the said Regulations including necessary communication with stock exchange(s) and capital market intermediaries such as Registrar and Transfer Agent or Depository Participant. It shall be duty of the concerned insurer to ensure compliance with the said Regulation.

chunks.heading: **E.1 Payment of Annual Fee [Refer Regulation 56 of Registration Regulations, 2024]:**
chunks.content:
After issuance of Certificate of Registration, the insurer shall remit the annual fee, computed in accordance with regulation 56(2), for: 

1. The financial year in which the said Certificate of Registration is granted, and 

2. The financial year succeeding the financial year referred in sub-clause 1 above, in case the Certificate of Registration is granted on or after 31<sup>st</sup> day of January of the financial year. Further, it is clarified that in case the Certificate of Registration is granted before 31<sup>st</sup> day of January of the financial year, the annual fee shall be remitted in accordance with Regulation 56.

chunks.heading: **F.1 With respect to Regulation 58(1)(a) of Registration Regulations, 2024:** The insurer may
chunks.content:
voluntarily surrender the Certificate of Registration granted to it and may request the Authority to cancel the same in the following cases: 

1. The business or a class of the business of the insurer has been transferred to any person pursuant to the Order of the Authority to this effect. 

2. The business or a class of the business of the insurer has been transferred to or amalgamated with the business of any other insurer after obtaining approval of the Authority. 

3. The insurer is not in the position to commence its operations, subsequent to grant of Certificate of Registration, within the stipulated time.
